Class AbstractByteCodeWriterTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Direct Known Subclasses:
BridgeTck, ByteCodeWriterTck, ControlFlowTck, ConversionTck, ExpressionTck, InferenceTck, LambdaAndReferenceTck, MemberTypeTck, OverloadSelectionTck, ReceiverTck, SignatureTck
public abstract class AbstractByteCodeWriterTck extends Object
The support shared by every topic of the bytecode writer TCK: writing definitions with the backend under test, loading them, and calling them next to javac's own call of a compiled fixture.

A backend runs a topic by extending it and implementing write(ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3

  • Method Details

    • write

      protected abstract byte[] write(ObjectDef definition)
      Writes one definition to class file bytes with the backend under test.

      An implementation should assert whatever its backend guarantees about how the bytes were produced, such as verifying them or refusing a fallback path, so that a backend cannot pass the TCK by quietly declining to write the definition itself.

      Parameters:
      definition - The definition to write
      Returns:
      The class file bytes

    • assertCall

      protected final void assertCall(Object expected, List<TypeDef> types, List<?> values, Function<List<ExpressionDef>, ExpressionDef> body) throws Exception
      Generates a static call method taking parameters of the given types, invokes it with the given values and asserts its result. The expected value is usually javac's own call of the same fixture, so that the generated call must choose what javac chooses.
      Parameters:
      expected - The expected result
      types - The parameter types of the generated method
      values - The arguments to call it with
      body - The expression the method returns, given its parameters
      Throws:
      Exception - If the class cannot be written, loaded or called
